_readme: Schema registry. One entry per document type. Loaded into document_intelligence.config.extraction_schemas by scripts/load_schema_registry.py. CORE fields (document_number, document_date, issuer_name, recipient_name, parties, currency, total_amount, language) are added to every type automatically by the pipeline, so do not repeat them here. Field properties: type = string | number | integer | boolean | enum (+labels) | array (+items) | object (+properties); description = hint for the model; format = date makes the gold column a DATE. Validation rules are SQL boolean expressions over the gold table columns (core + the fields below). ground_truth maps the answer key (truth.json) to this registry: truth_type is the type name used in truth.json, field_map maps truth.json field -> gold column.

ground_truth_supplement._source: Correct answers listed in HOW-TO-TEST.md that truth.json does not contain

document_number.description: Main identifier printed on the document: invoice/receipt number, case number, licence number, ID number, contract or letter reference

document_date.description: Main date of the document: invoice, transaction, issue, judgment, letter or effective date

issuer_name.description: Organisation or person that issued or authored the document (vendor, merchant, court, authority, sender, first party)

recipient_name.description: Customer, addressee, holder or counterparty the document is for

total_amount.description: Main monetary amount: grand total, contract value, amount claimed or awarded; null if none

document_types.description: Bill or tax invoice from a vendor requesting payment for goods or services
document_types.instructions: Supplier invoices. vendor_tax_id is the TRN / VAT / tax registration number. Line item amount = quantity x unit price.

due_date.description: Payment due date, only if a due date is printed on the invoice. Never calculate it from the invoice date and payment terms; return null if not printed.

tax_rate_percent.description: Tax / VAT rate in percent, e.g. 5

validation_rules.name: required_fields
validation_rules.expression: document_number IS NOT NULL AND issuer_name IS NOT NULL AND document_date IS NOT NULL AND total_amount IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: positive_total
validation_rules.expression: total_amount > 0

validation_rules.name: totals_reconcile
validation_rules.expression: abs(coalesce(subtotal, 0) + coalesce(shipping_amount, 0) + coalesce(tax_amount, 0) - total_amount) <= 0.05

validation_rules.name: tax_rate_consistent
validation_rules.expression: tax_rate_percent IS NULL OR tax_amount IS NULL OR abs(subtotal * tax_rate_percent / 100 - tax_amount) <= 0.05

validation_rules.name: line_items_sum
validation_rules.expression: abs(aggregate(try_variant_get(line_items, '$', 'ARRAY<VARIANT>'), 0D, (acc, x) -> acc + coalesce(try_variant_get(x, '$.amount', 'DOUBLE'), 0D)) - subtotal) <= 0.05

validation_rules.name: due_date_after_invoice_date
validation_rules.expression: due_date IS NULL OR due_date >= document_date

validation_rules.name: date_not_future
validation_rules.expression: document_date <= current_date()

validation_rules.name: trn_format
validation_rules.expression: vendor_tax_id IS NULL OR regexp_replace(vendor_tax_id, '[^0-9]', '') RLIKE '^[0-9]{15}$' OR currency <> 'AED'

validation_rules.name: not_duplicate
validation_rules.expression: count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY upper(issuer_name), document_number) = 1

document_types.description: Till or point-of-sale receipt for a purchase that has already been paid
document_types.instructions: Retail receipts, often phone photos. document_number is the receipt number.

validation_rules.name: required_fields
validation_rules.expression: issuer_name IS NOT NULL AND document_date IS NOT NULL AND total_amount IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: totals_reconcile
validation_rules.expression: subtotal IS NULL OR abs(subtotal + coalesce(tax_amount, 0) - total_amount) <= 0.05

validation_rules.name: items_sum
validation_rules.expression: subtotal IS NULL OR abs(aggregate(try_variant_get(items, '$', 'ARRAY<VARIANT>'), 0D, (acc, x) -> acc + coalesce(try_variant_get(x, '$.amount', 'DOUBLE'), 0D)) - subtotal) <= 0.05

validation_rules.name: date_not_future
validation_rules.expression: document_date <= current_date()

document_types.description: Business or visiting card with one person's name, title and contact details
document_types.instructions: Return every phone number and email printed on the card.

validation_rules.name: has_contact_name
validation_rules.expression: contact_name IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: has_contact_channel
validation_rules.expression: coalesce(array_size(try_variant_get(phones, '$', 'ARRAY<STRING>')), 0) + coalesce(array_size(try_variant_get(emails, '$', 'ARRAY<STRING>')), 0) > 0

validation_rules.name: email_format
validation_rules.expression: forall(coalesce(try_variant_get(emails, '$', 'ARRAY<STRING>'), array()), e -> e RLIKE '^[^@ ]+@[^@ ]+\\.[^@ ]+$')

document_types.description: Identity card, passport, residence permit, driving licence or similar personal ID
document_types.instructions: document_number is the ID / passport number, document_date is the date of issue, issuer_name is the issuing country or authority, recipient_name is the holder.

mrz_present.description: Machine-readable zone lines (with <<< characters) are printed

validation_rules.name: required_fields
validation_rules.expression: document_number IS NOT NULL AND full_name IS NOT NULL AND date_of_birth IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: dates_in_order
validation_rules.expression: date_of_birth < document_date AND document_date < date_of_expiry

validation_rules.name: not_expired
validation_rules.expression: date_of_expiry >= current_date()

document_types.description: Agreement between two or more parties setting out terms, obligations, duration and payment
document_types.instructions: document_date is the effective / start date, total_amount is the total contract value.

validation_rules.name: required_fields
validation_rules.expression: document_date IS NOT NULL AND contract_title IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: has_two_parties
validation_rules.expression: coalesce(array_size(parties), 0) >= 2

validation_rules.name: end_after_start
validation_rules.expression: end_date IS NULL OR end_date > document_date

validation_rules.name: has_signatories
validation_rules.expression: coalesce(array_size(try_variant_get(signatories, '$', 'ARRAY<STRING>')), 0) > 0

document_types.description: Formal legal notice or demand letter from a lawyer or party requiring action or payment
document_types.instructions: issuer_name is the law firm or sender, recipient_name the party being notified, total_amount the amount claimed, document_number the notice reference.

deadline_date.description: Only if an explicit date is printed

consequences.description: Risks / actions threatened if not complied with

validation_rules.name: required_fields
validation_rules.expression: issuer_name IS NOT NULL AND recipient_name IS NOT NULL AND document_date IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: has_deadline
validation_rules.expression: payment_deadline_days IS NOT NULL OR deadline_date IS NOT NULL

document_types.description: Court judgment, order or ruling issued in legal proceedings
document_types.instructions: document_number is the case number, document_date the judgment date, issuer_name the court, total_amount the amount awarded.

validation_rules.name: required_fields
validation_rules.expression: document_number IS NOT NULL AND claimant IS NOT NULL AND defendant IS NOT NULL AND document_date IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: hearing_after_judgment
validation_rules.expression: next_hearing_date IS NULL OR next_hearing_date > document_date

document_types.description: Power of attorney granting a person authority to act on behalf of another person or company
document_types.instructions: document_number is the notary reference, document_date the date signed.

validation_rules.name: required_fields
validation_rules.expression: grantor IS NOT NULL AND attorney IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: has_powers
validation_rules.expression: coalesce(array_size(try_variant_get(powers, '$', 'ARRAY<STRING>')), 0) > 0

validation_rules.name: valid_period
validation_rules.expression: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from

validation_rules.name: currently_valid
validation_rules.expression: current_date() BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to

document_types.description: Commercial or trade licence issued by an authority permitting a business to operate
document_types.instructions: document_number is the licence number, document_date the issue date, issuer_name the issuing authority, recipient_name the licensed company. List every person in the partners / owners / managers section, whatever their role.

partners_and_managers.description: Every partner, owner and manager listed on the licence

validation_rules.name: required_fields
validation_rules.expression: document_number IS NOT NULL AND recipient_name IS NOT NULL AND expiry_date IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: expiry_after_issue
validation_rules.expression: expiry_date > document_date

validation_rules.name: not_expired
validation_rules.expression: expiry_date >= current_date()

validation_rules.name: has_activities
validation_rules.expression: coalesce(array_size(try_variant_get(activities, '$', 'ARRAY<STRING>')), 0) > 0

validation_rules.name: has_partners
validation_rules.expression: coalesce(array_size(try_variant_get(partners_and_managers, '$', 'ARRAY<VARIANT>')), 0) > 0

validation_rules.name: partner_shares_total_100
validation_rules.expression: coalesce(aggregate(try_variant_get(partners_and_managers, '$', 'ARRAY<VARIANT>'), 0D, (acc, p) -> acc + coalesce(try_variant_get(p, '$.share_percent', 'DOUBLE'), 0D)), 0D) IN (0D, 100D)

document_types.description: Business letter, email or general correspondence, in English, Arabic or both
document_types.instructions: issuer_name is the sending organisation named in the letterhead (its English name), not the signatory and not a closing phrase. document_number is any reference quoted in the letter. For bilingual letters extract values once, in English.

validation_rules.name: required_fields
validation_rules.expression: document_date IS NOT NULL AND issuer_name IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: deadline_after_letter
validation_rules.expression: deadline_date IS NULL OR deadline_date >= document_date

document_types.description: Employee asset undertaking or handover form acknowledging receipt of a company asset such as a laptop, phone, SIM card, vehicle, keys, uniform or stamp
document_types.instructions: HR asset undertaking forms. issuer_name is the company that owns the asset, recipient_name is the employee receiving it. document_date is the date the asset was received, taken from the sentence 'confirm to have received on <date>'; ignore printed page headers or footers with a print date/time. document_number is the undertaking reference such as AST-003500-0119 (without the word Undertaking), not the form template code. Only the ticked asset category counts.

employee_number.description: Employee number or code, only if filled in

asset_condition.description: Condition stated at handover, e.g. Good

approver_name.description: Department or subsidiary head who approved

validation_rules.name: required_fields
validation_rules.expression: employee_name IS NOT NULL AND document_date IS NOT NULL AND (serial_number IS NOT NULL OR asset_model IS NOT NULL)

validation_rules.name: employee_signed
validation_rules.expression: employee_signed_date IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: approved
validation_rules.expression: approver_name IS NOT NULL AND approver_signed_date IS NOT NULL

validation_rules.name: signed_after_receipt
validation_rules.expression: employee_signed_date IS NULL OR employee_signed_date >= document_date

validation_rules.name: approved_after_employee
validation_rules.expression: approver_signed_date IS NULL OR employee_signed_date IS NULL OR approver_signed_date >= employee_signed_date

validation_rules.name: serial_not_duplicated
validation_rules.expression: serial_number IS NULL OR count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY upper(serial_number)) = 1

document_types.description: Any other kind of document that does not fit the types above
document_types.instructions: Capture whatever key facts the document contains.
